item.title: Stolen U-Haul prompts police chase through Philadelphia's Mayfair neighborhood
item.description: A stolen U-Haul truck led police on a chaotic chase through the Mayfair neighborhood. Police pursuit in Mayfair Philadelphia police say they spotted the stolen U-Haul just before 6:00 p.m. and attempted to stop it. The chase was initiated but quickly called off as it became too dangerous. Despite police backing off, they say the driver continued to drive erratically, hitting several cars.
